in_marathi.name: Amanya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amara’ meaning ‘Immortal’. This name is associated with the goddess Amrita, who is the personification of the elixir of immortality.

in_bengali.name: Amanya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amanya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amara’ meaning ‘Immortal’. This name is associated with the goddess Amrita, who is the personification of the elixir of immortality.
